digest.component_or_area: pytest fixtures and test environment isolation
propositions: Seven pytest fixtures copy complete os.environ into subprocess environment mappings and return those mappings directly or nested, exposing unrelated ambient credentials when pytest renders fixture arguments during test failures.

When pytest renders fixture arguments with default long traceback on test failure, saferepr serializes the full environment dict and leaks arbitrary inherited secrets that were copied from os.environ at fixture definition time.

Each of the seven fixtures must replace broad os.environ copy with an explicit allowlisted mapping containing only required PATH, state paths, and per-fixture configuration variables while remaining mutable for test-specific overrides.

Test behavior and subprocess contract requirements are satisfied by minimal PATH-only and explicit-variable-only environments; arbitrary ambient key inheritance is not required and poses unnecessary security risk.

Fixture environment allowlists must preserve fake-bin-first PATH for all seven fixtures, retain declarative per-fixture variables (HEALTH_TIMEOUT for health_gate, offset/log paths for observability), and remain mutable for existing test overrides.
